      "evidence_excerpt": "Schema mappings: \"hasUpperIceWaterlineCase\" links ship to upperIceWaterlineCase; \"waterlineCaseDisplacement\" has unitIri \"http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric\"; \"upperIceWaterlineDisplacement\" has unitIri \"http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric\"."

      "expected": "The quantity value should use the declared xsd:decimal canonical literal encoding.",
      "suggestion": "Restore sh:path qudt:value with sh:minCount 1, sh:maxCount 1, and sh:datatype xsd:decimal.",

      "expected": "A represented displacement quantity should have one numeric value and one unit equal to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric.",
      "suggestion": "Restore sh:path qudt:unit with sh:minCount 1, sh:maxCount 1, and sh:hasValue unit:KiloTON_Metric, together with the corresponding qudt:value cardinality constraint.",

      "previous_excerpt": "sh:sparql [\n        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;\n        sh:message \"The ship displacement must be the displacement of a linked upper ice waterline case having the greatest displacement.\" ;\n        sh:select \"\"\"\n            PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>\n            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>\n            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>\n\n            SELECT $this\n            WHERE {\n                $this nltl:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ?shipQuantity .\n                ?shipQuantity qudt:value ?shipDisplacement .\n\n                FILTER (\n                    NOT EXISTS {\n                        $this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?equalCase .\n                        ?equalCase nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?equalQuantity .\n                        ?equalQuantity qudt:value ?equalDisplacement .\n                        FILTER (\n                            xsd:decimal(str(?equalDisplacement)) =\n                            xsd:decimal(str(?shipDisplacement))\n                        )\n                    }\n                    ||\n                    EXISTS {\n                        $this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?greaterCase .\n                        ?greaterCase nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?greaterQuantity .\n                        ?greaterQuantity qudt:value ?greaterDisplacement .\n                        FILTER (\n                            xsd:decimal(str(?greaterDisplacement)) >\n                            xsd:decimal(str(?shipDisplacement))\n                        )\n                    }\n                )\n            }\n        \"\"\"\n    ]",

      "change_id": "ec5434003e9dfd99b38661a8e644da3a3ec016fa30506c655b09c2693d65b17c",
      "disposition": "REGRESSION",
      "exact_source_excerpt": "The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the upper ice waterline (UIWL).",

  ]
